struct Edge{
    int u;
    int v;
    int c;
    int r;
    Edge( int uu, int vv, int cc, int rr): u(uu), v(vv), c(cc), r(rr){}
};

vector< Edge > E;
vector< vector<int> > ady;

int maxflow( int source , int sink ){
    for( int f = 0; ;){
        vector<int> prev( ady.size() , -1 );
        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push( source );
        while( !Q.empty() ){
            int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
            for( int i = 0 ; i < ady[ u ].size(); ++i ){
                 int e = ady[ u ][ i ];
                 int v = E[ e ].v;
                 if( E[ e ].c == 0 || prev[ v ] >= 0 )continue;
                 Q.push( v );
                 prev[ v ] = e;
            }
        }
        if( prev[ sink ] < 0 )return f;
        int c = 0x7fffffff;
        for( int x = sink ; x != source ; x = E[ prev[ x ] ].u ){
            c = min(c, E[ prev[ x ] ].c);
        }
        for( int x = sink ; x != source ; x = E[ prev[ x ] ].u ){
            E[ prev[ x ] ].c -= c;
            E[ E[ prev[ x ] ].r ].c += c;
        }
        f += c;
    }
}

    Edge e1( u , v , c , E.size() + 1 );
    ady[ u ].push_back( E.size() );
    E.push_back( e1 );
    Edge e2( v , u , ( dirigido )? 0 : c , E.size() - 1 );
    ady[ v ].push_back( E.size() );
    E.push_back( e2 );
}

        for( int x = 0 ; x < n ; ++x )

                S[ x ][ y ][ i + 1 ] = S[ x ][ y ][ i ];

            for( int y = 0 ; y < n ; ++y ){
                if( S[ x ][ y ][ i ] == 'Z' ){

                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
